params.name: page
params.description:
For list pagination. The value of the opc-next-page response header from the previous "List" call.
For important details about how pagination works,
see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a
paginated "List" call. `1` is the minimum, `1000` is the maximum. For important details about
how pagination works, see [List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: status
params.description: A filter to return only resources their lifecycleState matches the given OperationStatus.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided. Default order for timeAccepted is descending.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either ascending or descending order.

params.name: operationType
